text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened on the way back from an outing 
with Sirius Symboli, as we passed by a 
shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...— Shall we stop by for a bit?
choice_data_list: Is there something you need to buy?
Is there something you need to buy?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm not the one with business here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Told ya before, didn't I? If you don't 
wanna end up on the losing side, you gotta 
start by knowing yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it— I remember one of 
her fans telling me something like that 
back when we bumped into each other."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Try putting them on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After looking around the store, she showed 
me a pair of straight-tip leather dress 
shoes. Why so suddenly...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After looking around the store, she showed 
me a pair of high-heeled pumps. Why so 
suddenly...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the mirror gave me an 
indescribable feeling. To borrow the 
phrase 'being worn by the clothes'—
choice_data_list:
(It feels like the shoes are wearing 
me...)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Well, about as expected. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Listen close. ...I have no interest in 
worthless things, nor do I have any time 
to waste on them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —You get what I mean, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her words from another angle, 
does that mean "it has value"...? Thinking 
about it that way, a surge of confidence 
welled up within me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you took the bait so easily. 
...Still, you've gotten a little more 
decent to watch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, after browsing the merchandise 
for a bit, we moved on to a dining bar.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"—By the way. Do you understand the 
psychology of people who buy luxury 
goods?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I hesitated, unsure of how to answer 
the sudden question, she spoke up first.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Because it makes you look high-class. 
Simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The wealth to buy luxury items, the 
confidence to pull them off— You can 
project all of that easily. Even if it's 
just a bluff.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In other words... You just gotta become 
like that too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Think back to how you looked just now. 
...It was better than usual, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Back yourself with things of value. And 
make yourself believe that you are 
valuable too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you pile conviction upon conviction, it 
will eventually become second nature and 
turn into the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand why she brought me to the 
shoe store. It must have been to tell me 
this.
choice_data_list:
Alright, I'm going to buy those shoes and 
head home...!

Could you tell me if anything else would 
suit me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...— Location. Store name. Customer 
service. Quality.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Did you take a good look at everything?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You can probably guess just how high a 
price is required, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember catching a fleeting glimpse of 
the price tag for a second. If I recall 
correctly... it was a terrifying amount.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is. —Buy it when you truly 
want it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was reminded once again that anything of 
value comes with a price to match...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're quite greedy, aren't you? ...Oh 
well. I'm the one who started this. I'll 
keep you company.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However... let's see. From V-tips to 
loafers, and even monk straps—you must 
master them all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However... let's see. From stilettos to 
wedge soles, and even chunky heels—you 
must master them all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bracing myself, I had them pick out shoes 
for me again. Trying on so many pairs of 
fine shoes made me feel like I'd gained a 
little confidence.
